title: Delicate Moroccan Chicken Msemen
description: A flavorful Mexican-inspired msemen filled with chicken, spices, and fresh herbs.
instructions: Prepare msemen dough according to package instructions.
In a small bowl, mix together cumin, paprika, and salt.
Season chicken breast with the spice mixture and cook in a skillet over medium-high heat until browned, about 5 minutes.
Transfer chicken to a baking sheet and bake for 15-20 minutes, or until cooked through.
Meanwhile, roll out msemen dough to a thickness of about 1/8 inch.
Place a piece of chicken in the center of each msemen round, followed by a sprinkle of cilantro and a squeeze of lime juice.
Fold msemen dough over the filling and press edges together to seal.
Cook msemen in a dry skillet over medium heat for 2-3 minutes on each side, or until crispy and golden brown.
